description: Left: bearded caveman (black hair and beard, yellow leopard-spot tunic, half-lidded scowling eyes) points right at a framed grayscale photo on a stand; photo shows two tornado funnels and a small dark long-neck dinosaur silhouette between them; white background.
One-frame change; composition unchanged (caveman left, photo right). Fine face detail (eyelid or mouth) not resolvable at tile scale; UNRESOLVED exact change.
Same composition as G0001: caveman pointing at tornado photo with dinosaur silhouette.
One-frame change; same framing. Face slightly different (brow/eyelid); UNRESOLVED exact change at tile scale.
Same composition: caveman pointing at tornado photo.

Smooth per-frame zoom into the framed photo: big caveman head and pointing hand grow then slide off to the left edge while the grayscale tornado photo expands to fill the whole frame (strip f39-f68, change fraction falls from 0.31 to 0.001). A small cartoon caveman (yellow tunic) stands on the photo ground lower left from about f49 and scales with the zoom. Thumb of small caveman points right.
Full-frame grayscale tornado photo with two funnels; small cartoon caveman lower left thumbing right; small dark long-neck silhouette between funnels.
Small caveman head/face redrawn (head tilt or expression) while body and photo unchanged; exact expression unresolved at tile scale.
Small caveman lower left on grayscale tornado photo, grinning/smirking toward right; photo unchanged.
Small caveman face changes again (more frontal frown); body and background unchanged.
Small caveman lower left on tornado photo; face frowning.
Only 634 pixels changed; no visible change at tile scale. UNRESOLVED whether a tiny blink.
Small caveman lower left on tornado photo; no visible change.

At f136 whole frame replaced: white background, smiling cartoon long-neck dinosaur (spotted back) left, grey sketchy tornado spiral rising right and growing in width until about f248. From f252 the dino neck spins like a rotor: several ghost heads stacked on a vertical swirl axis, rings around it, then dino tilts and drifts up-left out of frame (f314-f332) leaving debris specks; frame empty f336-f344; then a new dino drawing (whisker lines at mouth, grass tufts at feet) pops in left-centre f348. Continuous in-betweens every frame at 4-frame sampling.
White background; medium dino centre-left with whisker lines at mouth and two grass tufts at feet; calm smile.
Dino redrawn larger with neck bent down and head low at left, small smiling face; centre of frame; no grass.
Large dino with head drooping down at left of body, tail up right; white background.
Dino redrawn slightly smaller; neck end now drooped to lower left, ending in a grey pixelated circular mosaic block instead of a head.
Dino with neck hanging down to lower left ending in a pixelated grey ball; white background.
Dino redrawn with neck stretched horizontally to the left ending in the pixelated grey ball; short speed marks on neck; body lower and legs apart.
Dino body right, neck extended straight left like a rigid shaft ending in pixelated ball.
Whole frame replaced by full-body front-facing caveman centred, grinning, both thumbs up at chest, yellow leopard tunic with jagged hem, barefoot.
Full-body caveman, grin, two thumbs up.

Close bust of caveman filling frame: heavy brow, big nose, gap-toothed grin, thick beard, small heart tattoo reading GRUG on chest. Possibly punch-in of same character; drawing detail differs from full-body so treated as new image.
Caveman bust, wide grin, brow level.
Caveman brow changes to an angled-up arch and eye shape shifts; framing unchanged.
Caveman bust, angled brow, grin.
Subtle brow/eye change; framing unchanged; fine detail unresolved at tile scale.
Caveman bust, grin, brow raised.
Subtle brow/eye change; fine detail unresolved at tile scale.
Caveman bust, grin.
Subtle brow/eye change; fine detail unresolved at tile scale.
Caveman bust, grin, brow raised.
Whole frame replaced: white background, frowning dino with spotted back, a cloud of swirly wind puffs with speed lines wrapping its neck from the left.
Dino with wind puffs wrapping neck from left, long hold.
Black solid silhouette of long-neck dino, facing left, centred on white.
Black dino silhouette, centred.
Small curved black arrow appears above the silhouette head pointing right (clockwise).
Black dino silhouette with one arrow above head pointing right.
Second curved arrow appears on the neck/back area pointing left (opposite direction to head arrow).
Black silhouette with two opposing curved arrows: one above head pointing right, one on body pointing left.
Whole frame replaced by a very large crop of dino lower body: belly spots at top, four legs, two small knee faces with worried open mouths and wiggle lines at the sides.
Dino legs with two panicked knee faces and shake lines; long hold.
Small dino centred whose neck is twisted into a corkscrew; head has googly spiral eyes and tongue out.
Dino with corkscrew neck and dizzy face.
Whole frame replaced by a rendered green cartoon dino (Yoshi-like 3D character with red shoes) running to the right, centred on white; photo-style, not line art.
Green running dino character centred on white.
Whole frame replaced by line-art feathered raptor standing upright, tongue out, wide eyes, heavy brow, arms bent left; centred.
Feathered raptor standing, tongue out.
Raptor line art begins to fade: outlines turn from black to mid grey over frames 1460-1466.
Slow colour drift: first tile raptor outlines mid-grey, mid tile (f1487) very light grey, last tile (f1507) blank white. Continuation of fade-out.

New raptor pose fades in from white (f1508-f1516): flying with arms spread, eyes closed contented smile, curved wind lines around body. After f1518 the drawing is visually constant; changed fraction pulses (0.01-0.05) in bursts around f1528-f1534 and f1544-f1600, consistent with subtle wobble or wind-line shift; exact element UNRESOLVED.
Flying raptor, arms spread, eyes closed smile, wind lines.

Frames f1630-f1635 still full-body flying raptor with small wind-line shifts; by f1638 whole frame replaced with large close-up of raptor head: star-shaped eyes, tear streak, wide open smile, sparkle lines at upper left.
Raptor head close-up, star eyes, tear, big smile, sparkle lines.
Tiny change (2.5k px) on otherwise constant close-up; element unresolved at tile scale, possibly eye stars or tear; UNRESOLVED.
Raptor head close-up, star eyes, tear, smile.

Same head framing; expression switches from joy to terror: wide round eyes, open jaw with sharp teeth, sweat drops, jagged alarm marks upper left.
Raptor head close-up, terrified wide eyes, teeth showing, sweat drops.

At f1815 whole frame replaced: raptor falling head-down toward lower left, terrified face, claws up, diagonal speed lines; small jitter pulses (change fraction 0.02-0.06) while falling; at f1853 last frame cut to a blank outline rock.
Large empty outline boulder centred on white.
Small falling raptor slides in from the right edge (f1880, f1882) and at f1885 appears splatted on the right side of the rock as a grey pixelated mosaic shape with red blood splatter.
Boulder with pixelated grey raptor splat and red marks on its right side.
Whole frame replaced: small line-art long-neck dino with heavy brow standing centred, facing right, tail left.
Small heavy-browed long-neck dino centred.
Single-step jump to large scale of the same dino (head near top, legs cropped at bottom); drawing appears same; could instead be a cut to a redrawn larger version.
Large dino, head upper right, legs cropped by frame bottom.
Dino scaled down and standing on left pan of a balance scale; empty right pan; scale post and base appear.
Dino on left pan of balance scale, right pan empty and raised.
Small house with windows and door appears on the right pan of the scale.
Dino on left pan, house on right pan, beam tilted with dino side lower.
Scale and house removed; dino shown large again, same framing as G0101 (head top, legs cropped). May be a cut to the earlier large drawing; UNRESOLVED.
Large dino alone, no text.
Yellow rounded label with lowercase black handwritten-style text patagotitan appears upper left of the large dino.
Large dino with yellow label patagotitan upper left.
Label gone; dino redrawn smaller and centred, smirking, with two small wings on its sides. Could be zoom-out plus wings pop-on of same character; treated as new image.
Smaller dino with two tiny wings, smirk.
Dino expression to worried frown; red target crosshair appears on its body side; wings remain.
Worried winged dino with red crosshair on side.
Whole frame replaced: angry muscular tornado character with fanged grin holding a bazooka-like cannon labelled DEBRIS GUN, aimed left.
Muscular tornado with DEBRIS GUN cannon, left of centre.
Whole frame replaced by blank white.
Blank white frame.

Props slide right to left across white with in-betweens: outline tree branch (f2698-f2742), outline rock (f2742-f2780), green rendered T-rex toy (f2772-f2814), then flying caveman in brown tunic with yellow cape and fist forward, slightly rotated (f2816-f2884); frame ends blank.
Blank white frame.
Outline trampoline slides in from the right (f2891), tilts slightly, passes centre and exits left (f2944); frame ends blank.
Very pale grey ghost of a forest (three trees, bushes) at near-zero opacity on white; start of fade-in.
Forest fades in from very light grey to full black outline over about 12 frames; trees and bushes unchanged in position.
Intact forest line art: three trees, ferns, bushes, ground.
Forest replaced by smaller wrecked version: broken tree trunk, fallen log, leaves in the air, flattened bushes.
Wrecked forest with fallen logs and flying leaves.

From blank white, a dense field of black spear-like arrows pointing right enters from the left (f3106-f3122), fills the frame, then exits right (f3184-f3204); arrow heads appear blurred as if with motion blur; ends blank.
Blank white frame.
Whole frame replaced: caveman in yellow mortarboard cap with tassel stands right beside a blackboard reading lesson, pointer touching the word, grumpy brow.
Teacher caveman, blackboard reading lesson.
Minor face change of teacher caveman (about 15k px); unresolved detail at tile scale.
Teacher caveman, blackboard lesson.
Minor face change again; unresolved detail.
Teacher caveman, blackboard lesson.
Whole frame replaced: feathered raptor standing upright, tongue out, wide eyes, arms bent left, upper right of frame; appears to be the G0048 drawing re-used.
Feathered raptor standing, tongue out.
Whole frame replaced: blank boulder with pixelated grey raptor splat and red marks on its right side; appears to be the G0097 image re-used.
Boulder with raptor splat.
A cartoon eyeball with trailing optic nerve falls from upper left to lower left with motion lines (f3356-f3364) while the boulder fades to a soft blur.
Eyeball on ground lower left, blurred boulder with splat behind.
Whole frame replaced: smiling spotted long-neck dino standing centre-left; appears to be the G0014 first drawing re-used.
Smiling spotted long-neck dino.
Dino redrawn smaller with neck folded like paper at a sharp angle and head down with small impact marks.
Dino with folded neck, head low at left.
Whole frame replaced: large calm standing dino, heavy brow, no label; same design as G0107.
Large calm long-neck dino.
Dino redrawn smaller and sad-eyed, covered with twigs and branches stuck on body and tail. Possibly same character redrawn; treated as new image.
Sad dino covered in twigs.
Whole frame replaced: smiling tornado character with heart eyes, open happy mouth, puffy cloud-like arms spread, left of frame.
Heart-eyed tornado left, empty space right.
Caveman with heart eyes appears at right, hands clasped to cheek, one leg lifted as if skipping; tornado unchanged.
Heart-eyed tornado left, heart-eyed caveman right.
Whole frame replaced: small T-rex-like dino standing centred, heavy drooping eyelids, frown, spiky back, small arms.
Grumpy standing dino centred.
Same standing dino redrawn larger with meat-like texture: drumstick thighs, rib cage and armoured plate back, stippled shading; frown kept.
Meat-textured dino with drumstick legs and rib spine.
Dino outlines begin fading from black to grey over f3878-f3882.
Colour drift to white: first tile dino mid-grey, mid tile (f3900) very pale, last tile (f3917) near blank; fade-out continues to end of video. No text or call to action visible.
